bash: cat README.md attendance.py migrate.py docs/schema.md .gitignore pytest.ini tests/test_attendance.py; echo ----; cat data/attendance.csv

invocations: python migrate.py build/normalized.csv && cat data/attendance.csv && cat outbox/migration.json && cmp build/normalized.csv data/attendance.csv && echo identical
bash:
mkdir -p /tmp/fu-scripts build && cat > /tmp/fu-scripts/build_preview.py <<'EOF'
import csv, sys
from datetime import datetime
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from attendance import load, as_utc

rows = load()
best = {}
for r in rows:
    k = (r["badge"], r["session"])
    t = datetime.fromisoformat(r["observed_at"])
    if k in best:
        bt = datetime.fromisoformat(best[k]["observed_at"])
        if t == bt:
            raise SystemExit(f"tie on observed_at for {k}")
        if t < bt:
            continue
    best[k] = r
with open("build/normalized.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["badge", "session", "start_utc"])
    for k in sorted(best):
        if best[k]["status"] != "cancelled":
            w.writerow([k[0], k[1], as_utc(best[k]["started_at"])])
EOF
cp data/attendance.csv build/attendance.legacy.csv
python /tmp/fu-scripts/build_preview.py && cat build/normalized.csv
python migrate.py build/normalized.csv && cat data/attendance.csv && cat outbox/migration.json && cmp build/normalized.csv data/attendance.csv && echo identical
